You can investigate in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/4170d7c9a3ee4adc729330a7cba90527aca2dbc5/packages/vue-instantsearch/src/components/DynamicWidgets.js#L71-L81 whether the value of `getDefaultSlot` in this case is actually an array that is traversable to get a map of all widgets.

What you can do as well is fork the dynamic widgets widget and change the code where it searches children for what to render for which attribute with a Map you create yourself that you would have used to render in the children of dynamic widgets.
